text: Implemented explicit GiftiTransformSelection and rich GiftiDecodedSurface with original transform metadata, typed native/transformed placement and target space. Default refuses ambiguous/unknown targets, missing transforms remain documented native coordinates; explicit target selection is permutation-invariant and rejects same-target ambiguity. Matrix stored only in surfaceToWorld, preserving native Float64 mesh coordinates and exact provider affine error causes. Same 18 public-reader cases execute JVM/JS covering independent landmarks, double-application guard, ambiguity, ordering, unknown/missing/identity targets, explicit index, non-affine matrix and convenience defaults. surfaceJVM144/surfaceJS118 plus atlasJVM90/atlasJS62 tests passed without warnings. README/NEWS document source-frame versus registration evidence. Log /private/tmp/next-five-placement-final.log.
